title: Ecotourism: good or bad?
questions: What are the main ideas you learned from this episode? Please give a brief summary in your own words.
When does ecotourism genuinely help nature, and when is it mostly marketing?
Can large numbers of tourists ever visit a fragile natural area sustainably?
Should tourists pay higher fees to enter protected areas?
How can local communities benefit from ecotourism without losing control of their land or culture?
Would you accept fewer comforts on holiday if it significantly reduced environmental damage?
